# Illustrative ecosystem assets

These marks identify example vendors in the marketing diagram. They do not indicate
available integrations, partnerships, endorsements, or customers. Assets were
retrieved from vendor-operated websites on 2026-11-23 and retain their original
brand colors. Vendor trademarks remain the property of their owners.

| Vendor | Official source |
| --- | --- |
| Stream | https://getstream.io/assets/_variants/images/stream-dark-402w-36a3281f.webp (header logo on https://getstream.io) |
| Mux | https://www.mux.com/images/mux-logo.svg |
| Hive | Inline header SVG from https://thehive.ai (viewBox added for responsive scaling) |
| Persona | https://pds.withpersona.com/persona-logo.svg; guidance: https://pds.withpersona.com/foundations/logos/ |
| SEON | https://seon.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/seon-full-1.svg |
| Auth0 | https://cdn.auth0.com/website/website/favicons/auth0-favicon.svg |
| Zendesk | https://d1eipm3vz40hy0.cloudfront.net/images/logos/favicons/zendesk-icon.svg; guidance: https://www.zendesk.com/company/brand-guidelines/ |
| Cinder | Inline header SVG labeled Cinder from https://www.cinder.co |

Stream's official header uses WebP; the other marks use SVG. Assets are hosted
locally so visitor browsers do not contact vendor sites to render this section.
